card.name: Dot inside section numbers
card.fires_on: The period or colon right after a digit in numbered section headings or step numbers, such as 2.6.4 or 5.11. It also fires a little on separators inside codes or times.

modes.label: Section number dot
modes.description: The period between digits in a numbered heading or step, just before the next number.

card.writes: It seems to favor a following digit or code piece and suppresses a plain period, so it points to the number continuing.
card.plain: It marks the dot inside a numbered heading like 2.6 or 5.11, where another number comes next.
